My immediate focus involves modifying `OnboardingFunnel.tsx` to include these selectors and potentially reviewing the `SeekerProfile` type. I've chosen a 2-column grid layout for these components within `OnboardingFunnel.tsx`. I'll update the `SeekerProfile` interface in `types.ts` to include age as a number. This will feed through to the display in `SeekerProfileDashboardPanel.tsx`. Finally, I'm integrating the Gemini integration with these new selections in `OnboardingFunnel.tsx` by updating the `weaveIdentity` function.

It's becoming clear that `SeekerGender` already exists in `types.ts`, so the main tasks involve making sure the UI properly displays these selectors. I'll update `SeekerProfile` to include age, add the corresponding UI controls in `OnboardingFunnel.tsx`, and ensure both `SeekerProfileDashboardPanel.tsx` and `SeekerProfileWeaverPanel.tsx` show these new details. Finally, I'll ensure the visual design fits with the "Data Slate" style.
